gloss: to organize; to form; to compose (a group)

definitions.gloss: to organize; to form; to compose; to put together
definitions.explanation: To assemble people, units, or elements into an organized group or structure. Used for forming teams, military units, train configurations, budgets, and other organized arrangements.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}する。
⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}する⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The work of putting together the budget has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めて→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}した。
examples.english: They gathered experts and formed an investigation committee.

notes:
Emphasizes the deliberate assembly and arrangement of components into an organized whole. The resulting group has structure and purpose, not just a random collection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}する: to form a team
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}する: to draw up a budget
- ⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編成|へんせい}する: to organize a military unit
- ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}→編成：20615_hensei⟧: program scheduling (TV/radio)
- ⟦{列車|れっしゃ}→列車：01670_ressha⟧⟦{編成|へんせい}→編成：20615_hensei⟧: train composition/formation
- ⟦{編成|へんせい}→編成：20615_hensei⟧{替|が}え: reorganization

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to organize — broader, focuses on creating an organizational structure
- ⟦{結成|けっせい}→結成：13809_kessei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to form / to establish — for newly creating a group, party, or alliance
- ⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compose / to make up — focuses on what elements something consists of

REGISTER:
Formal. Standard in administrative, military, and media contexts. In casual speech, people more often say ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ or ⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組|く}む→組む：02050_kumu⟧.
